purpose: Structured representation of the Urania-Weltzeituhr, Alexanderplatz, as a physical object rather than a text string. Built so that later experiments can read it in physically meaningful ways. Fields carry confidence grades: PRIMARY VERIFIED / MULTIPLE INDEPENDENT SOURCES / SINGLE RELIABLE SOURCE / INFERRED / UNKNOWN. UNKNOWN fields are NOT filled with modern data.
contamination_note: No claimed-K4-solution site was used as a source. See docs/contamination-log.md.

identity.name: Urania-Weltzeituhr
identity.designer: Erich John, within the Alexanderplatz redesign planning group led by Walter Womacka

construction.on_site_execution: Hans-Joachim Kunsch, metalsmith and metal sculptor
construction.team: about 120 specialists across trades, including the Coswig gear factory; built with volunteer after-work brigades
construction.lettering: city names composed of STAMPED letters on aluminium plates
construction.note: Stamped lettering implies physical letter punches/templates existed. Whether any survive is UNKNOWN.

geometry.form: three-part cylinder with 24 corners and 24 sides, on a column

three_parts.middle: rotating hour ring - 24 reddish-brown enamelled rectangular plates with gilded numerals, carrying the hours through the time zones
three_parts.note: This is the upper/lower band structure. Which names sit upper versus lower is UNKNOWN.

rotation.cylinder: STATIC - the city-name cylinder does not rotate
rotation.hour_ring: rotates, driven by a converted Trabant gearbox
rotation.orrery: simplified solar system above the cylinder, rotates once per minute about its own axis
rotation.correction_note: Earlier notes in this repository described the cylinder itself as rotating. That was wrong.

base.confidence: HIGH for presence, UNKNOWN for the number of marked points

orientation_relative_to_north.why_it_matters: Any reading that starts from a compass bearing - which EASTNORTHEAST would supply - requires knowing which sector faces which direction. Without it, a bearing cannot be converted into a sector. Note also that with 24 faces every 15 degrees, ANY bearing lies within 7.5 degrees of a face centre, so proximity alone carries no information.

reconstruction_status.verdict: Blocker 1 CLOSED for the modern endpoint. The dominant blocker has CHANGED IDENTITY: it is no longer which names were on the clock, but where they sat.
reconstruction_status.method_that_would_work: Take the published modern per-sector list, reverse the 2015 change set, subtract the 20 names added in 1997, reverse the documented renames, and revert the documented zone reassignments.
blocking_items: 1. modern per-sector list - CLOSED 2026-09-12. Official Weltzeituhr Berlin list of 146 places with UTC assignments supplied and validated; stored in data/weltzeituhr_modern_official.json, marked MODERN.
2. full list of ~20 names added in 1997 - PARTIAL: 6 of 20 (Jerusalem, Tel Aviv, Kapstadt, Oslo, Seoul, Managua). 14 unnamed.
3. full list of 1997 zone reassignments - PARTIAL: only Kiew; origin sector INFERRED as UTC+3.
5. upper-versus-lower band assignment - UNKNOWN for all 146. NOW THE DOMINANT BLOCKER (see item 8).
6. cylinder orientation relative to north - UNKNOWN.
7. RETIRED. 2015 was MONUMENT PROTECTION, not a restoration. Checkpoint F's seventh blocker was a misreading and is withdrawn.

8. NEW AND DOMINANT: physical ORDER of names within each sector. EXP-026 shows that even a perfect 1989 name list leaves ~10^125 arrangements consistent with it, because EXP-024's procedures read bands in physical order. A name list can NEVER unblock the test. Band and order are recoverable only from dated, legible photographs of the drum.

highest_value_archival_target.value: Correspondence between the Berlin Senatsbauverwaltung and the LANGUAGE SERVICE OF THE AUSWAERTIGES AMT in Bonn, plus the Senatskanzlei, concerning the 1997 Weltzeituhr spellings.
highest_value_archival_target.basis: The Senatsbauverwaltung publicly stated in December 1997 that the spellings were coordinated with those bodies (Berliner Zeitung, 'Preszburg oder Bratislava?').
highest_value_archival_target.why: A single correspondence file would enumerate every name and spelling decided in 1997, closing blockers 2, 3 and 4 at once.
highest_value_archival_target.confidence: SINGLE RELIABLE SOURCE for the coordination claim

history: Opposition demonstrators gathered at the clock on 7 October 1989 during the GDR's 40th-anniversary celebrations; the Wall fell 33 days later.
